fields.name: imageAction
fields.description: Verb phrase describing the action to be performed in the image.

fields.name: shared
fields.description: Whether the config is meant to be shared internally across generations.

fields.name: hires
fields.description: Whether to use the refiner.

fields.name: model
fields.description: SDXL checkpoint. This default is only a last resort - checkpoint names are per-deployment, so set the 'sd.default.model' config (Service7 init-param / Console7 resource.properties) rather than relying on it. Was 'sdXL_v10VAEFix.safetensors', which does not exist on the local Swarm server; this value is verified present there and matches test.swarm.model.

fields.name: negativePrompt
fields.description: Negative prompt for image generation. Quality exclusions applied by default when empty.

fields.name: groupPath
fields.description: Target group path for generated image storage.

fields.name: imageName
fields.description: Output file name for the generated image.

fields.name: sceneCreativity
fields.description: initImageCreativity for landscape-to-scene merge. 0.0 = exact copy, 1.0 = ignore landscape. Recommended: 0.55-0.70.

fields.name: skipLandscape
fields.description: When true, skip landscape reference generation and use text-only scene prompt (single-stage generation).

fields.name: useKontext
fields.description: When true, use FLUX Kontext stitch-and-prompt pipeline for scene compositing instead of classic Graphics2D + SDXL img2img. Ignored when compositeMode is set.

fields.name: compositeMode
fields.description: Scene composite pipeline: 'flux2' (FLUX.2 multi-reference, recommended), 'kontext' (FLUX Kontext stitched panel strip), or 'classic' (Graphics2D paste + SDXL img2img). When unset, falls back to the legacy useKontext boolean.

fields.name: flux2Model
fields.description: FLUX.2 checkpoint for multi-reference scene compositing.

fields.name: flux2Cfg
fields.description: CFG scale for the FLUX.2 composite. Edit/reference models want a low value: 1.0-3.5, 2.5 recommended. Do NOT reuse the SDXL cfg (5-7) here.

fields.name: flux2ReferenceSize
fields.description: Square size each FLUX.2 reference image is normalized to (aspect preserved, letterboxed - never center-cropped).

fields.name: flux2Steps
fields.description: Sampling steps for the FLUX.2 composite (20-28 recommended). Separate from the shared 'steps' field, which is SDXL-tuned for portraits/landscape; leave unset to use 24.

fields.name: flux2Width
fields.description: Width of the FLUX.2 composite. Separate from the shared 'width' field so an SDXL-tuned square size cannot force the scene out of landscape; leave unset to use 1024.

fields.name: flux2Height
fields.description: Height of the FLUX.2 composite. Leave unset to use 768 (landscape, matching the classic pipeline).

fields.name: kontextModel
fields.description: FLUX Kontext model name for scene compositing. NOTE: not installed on every Swarm server (absent from the local one as of 2026-08-07) - a missing checkpoint returns an empty image list rather than an error, so set this explicitly if you use compositeMode=kontext.

fields.name: kontextSteps
fields.description: Sampling steps for FLUX Kontext generation.

fields.name: kontextCfg
fields.description: CFG scale for FLUX Kontext (FLUX uses internal guidance, typically 1).

fields.name: kontextSampler
fields.description: Sampler for FLUX Kontext generation.

fields.name: kontextScheduler
fields.description: Scheduler for FLUX Kontext generation.

fields.name: landscapeSetting
fields.description: Transient landscape setting description passed from client for landscape reference generation.

fields.name: loras
fields.description: List of LORA entries in format loraName:weight (e.g., myLora:0.8). Appended to prompts as comma-separated list.
